prose: The Financial Times reports OpenEvidence says nearly two-thirds of the roughly one million US physicians use its AI search engine, and a source says it is on track to generate $400-500 million in 2026 advertising revenue. The article is paywalled and could not be fetched, so this summary is limited to the headline.
highlights: OpenEvidence: nearly two-thirds of ~1M US physicians use its AI search
On track for $400-500M in 2026 ad revenue, per a source
Source: Rafe Rosner-Uddin, FT, via Techmeme
basis: Basis: Techmeme headline only; the FT article is paywalled and the fetch returned an error.
